# RepayWise

> Free, independent UK mortgage calculators. No login, no credit check, no bank affiliation.

RepayWise is a free UK mortgage calculator suite covering repayment, overpayment, stamp duty, affordability, equity, buy-to-let, remortgage, rate comparison, salary-to-mortgage, fix-or-track, and home improvement calculations. All tools run entirely in the browser with no server-side data collection.

## Calculators

- [Mortgage Repayment Calculator](https://repaywise.co.uk/calculators/repayment): Monthly payment and total interest for any UK mortgage.
- [Overpayment Calculator](https://repaywise.co.uk/calculators/overpayment): See how overpaying saves interest and cuts your mortgage term.
- [Stamp Duty Calculator](https://repaywise.co.uk/calculators/stamp-duty): SDLT (England), LBTT (Scotland), LTT (Wales) with FTB relief and surcharges.
- [Max Borrowing Calculator](https://repaywise.co.uk/calculators/max-borrowing): How much can you borrow based on income, deposit, and stress test.
- [Home Equity Calculator](https://repaywise.co.uk/calculators/equity): See how much of your home you own vs the bank.
- [Buy-to-Let Calculator](https://repaywise.co.uk/calculators/buy-to-let): Rental yield, cash flow, ICR stress test, and stamp duty surcharge.
- [Affordability Calculator](https://repaywise.co.uk/calculators/affordability): Total cost to buy including deposit, stamp duty, EMI, and fees.
- [Remortgage Calculator](https://repaywise.co.uk/calculators/remortgage): Compare current deal vs new rate with break-even analysis.
- [Rate Comparison](https://repaywise.co.uk/calculators/rate-compare): Compare up to 5 mortgage rates side-by-side.
- [Fix or Track Calculator](https://repaywise.co.uk/calculators/fix-or-track): Fixed vs tracker mortgage with Bank of England rate scenarios.
- [Salary to Mortgage](https://repaywise.co.uk/calculators/salary-to-mortgage): Enter salary, see mortgage amount with UK income multiples.
- [Home Improvement](https://repaywise.co.uk/calculators/home-improvement): Personal loan vs remortgage comparison for renovation funding.

## Lender-Specific Calculators

RepayWise offers calculator variants pre-loaded with indicative SVR rates for 150+ UK lenders including Barclays, Nationwide, HSBC, Halifax, Lloyds, Santander, NatWest, Coventry Building Society, Virgin Money, and Danske Bank.

## Key Facts

- Domain: repaywise.co.uk
- Country: United Kingdom
- Privacy: Zero tracking cookies, no personal data collection
- Independence: Not affiliated with any bank, building society, or mortgage broker
- Precision: All calculations use 28-digit decimal arithmetic
